_help: "answer" is the number of the correct option, counting from 1. You can add or remove questions and options; the build checks that every answer number is valid.

questions.question: Who should own client and planner contact on the day of the event?
questions.feedback: The event lead runs the day, including client and planner contact. That role is never optional.

questions.question: Why does THC ServePro certification help you get booked by venues and planners?
options: It shows every server trained to the same written standard of service
It makes the event legal in any state
It replaces the need for insurance
It lets you skip ID checks
questions.feedback: Certification shows a consistent, documented standard. It does not make an event legal or replace permits or insurance.

questions.question: Which is the best way to use certified service as a selling point?
options: Promise clients there is no risk
Mention it only if the client asks
State it in proposals and offer a roster with certification dates
Tell clients certification covers their liability
questions.feedback: Put it in writing and back it up with a roster. Don't overclaim what certification does.
